pages.text: Spikes hurt living creatures that touch them. Wooden Spikes can weaken a mob but leave it at half a heart. Stone and Iron Spikes can finish it. Use the material recipes to choose the right tier for your farm.

pages.title: Experience & Loot
pages.text: Gold Spikes cause eligible mobs to drop experience. Diamond Spikes count as a player kill for special mob loot and suppress experience. Select the tier by what you want to collect.

pages.title: Creative Spikes
pages.text: Creative Spikes deal very high damage on contact. This tier is available from Creative.
